existingReportSummary.executiveSummaryMd: `MeasureReport` has stable identity but multiple local breaking changes. The top concerns are report-type code churn, choice-element serialization changes, improvement-notation relocation, Location reporter removal, and new count constraints. The main uncertainty is enforcement of narrative SHALL language and exact terminology expansion behavior.
existingReportSummary.migrationThemesMd: Migration requires JSON rewrites for choices, code mapping for `data-collection`, semantic review for reporter Location and improvement notation, count/countQuantity validation policy, and extension/loss handling for R6-only fields.
existingReportSummary.confidenceSummaryMd: Confidence is high for computable StructureDefinition differences because both assigned files were present. Confidence is medium for terminology expansion details and narrative conformance behavior.

compatibilityLeverage.note: Resource-level leverage is a planning signal. It does not mark individual Revisit findings as justified or unimportant.

rationaleMd:
MeasureReport keeps its resource identity. The aggregate has 7 hard R4-to-R6 instance break(s), 2 potential hard break(s), 4 non-mechanical migration finding(s), and 4 direct behavior/API finding(s).

R4 maturity context is trial-use/FMM 2, which creates neutral stability pressure.

The computed migration-unavoidability score is 100/100, producing migration shape `major-model-remodel`, major migration `Yes`, and compatibility posture `preserve-where-low-cost-but-expect-resource-migration`.

8 finding(s) identify a yes/partial less-breaking base-design alternative, so the aggregate should not be used to dismiss local avoidability review.

10 shared Resource/DomainResource behavior finding(s) are listed as context but not scored for this resource to avoid duplicating base behavior issues across all resources.
recommendedStandardsPostureMd: Expect targeted migration work, but continue reviewing individual breaks. Use less-breaking designs where they do not preserve obsolete or conflicting models indefinitely.

topFindings.title: Root improvementNotation was removed and replaced by group-level improvementNotation
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: old root `improvementNotation` is absent in R6; runtime/API/codegen paths also move from a resource-level property to group-level properties.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: MeasureReport.reporter no longer accepts Location references
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: an R4 `reporter` pointing to a Location no longer satisfies the R6 target list; mapping to `location` can change reporter-vs-subject-location semantics.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: R6 population constraints require exactly one of count or countQuantity
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: R4 populations with neither `count` nor `countQuantity` fail R6 `xor`; R6 Quantity counts also create R6-to-R4 loss unless safely reducible to integer.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.
